fasta: none on either side: the plugin reads its own FASTA, the reference genome is not passed
input: variants.vcf: the 92 chromosome 21 sequence variants of the GRCh38 corpus with their INFO columns dropped, three of its symbolic structural variants (a duplication, a deletion, an inversion), and ten hand-built records chosen on the ancestral sequence's own text: a low-confidence (lower-case) call, a failed call (N), an insertion in the extant species (-), a site without alignment coverage (.), a deletion spanning a change of case, a two-base substitution, a chr-prefixed name, a multi-allelic SNV, a deletion and insertion sharing their anchor base, and an intergenic site; every record's reference allele read from the GRCh38 primary assembly
plugin_data: ancestral/homo_sapiens_ancestor_21.slice.fa.gz: chromosome 21 of Ensembl's homo_sapiens_ancestor_GRCh38 archive (release 116 ftp path, md5 d29338514407ac418643404d8e8471f5) under its own record name, the 200 bases either side of every record kept and every other base rewritten to `.` (no coverage), cut after the last window, bgzipped with its .fai and .gzi; ancestral/homo_sapiens_ancestor_X_only.slice.fa.gz: one 1,000-base record of `.` named as chromosome X, so a chromosome 21 record reaches no record and reads `?`
generator: the records assembled by hand, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --k 500 --max-span 0 --multi-allelic-per-suite 50 over the Ensembl VEP default output of the same records (every record named with --include, 87 names); scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice of the converted Ensembl VEP cache; the expected outputs from the release_116.2 image with the harness's corpus invocation (--fork 1 --buffer_size 5000, headers kept), the plugin and corpus directory passed as the manifest flags with {corpus} the read-only mount of the corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify --field AA for the manifest's run and for the flag set
expected_outputs: expected/: the default run; expected_fasta-without-the-chromosome/: the flag set that points the plugin at the chromosome X slice
